Implementation spec — Stabilizer overlay at 10% per ticker:

  • XBI → Type C — hold when above 200DMA; exit when below (IR: 0.77 | MaxDD: -21.8% | ΔDD: NA pp)

  • LIT → Type C — hold when above 200DMA; exit when below (IR: 0.82 | MaxDD: -21.8% | ΔDD: NA pp)

  • KRE → Type B — hold in Recovery + Consolidation; exit in Fall (IR: 0.68 | MaxDD: -21.7% | ΔDD: NA pp)

  • COPX → Type C — hold when above 200DMA; exit when below (IR: 0.82 | MaxDD: -20.6% | ΔDD: NA pp)

  • XLE → Type C — hold when above 200DMA; exit when below (IR: 0.86 | MaxDD: -20.6% | ΔDD: NA pp)

Trigger type legend

A — Unconditional: blend held always at fixed weight. No switching cost. Suitable when the ticker adds value in all regimes.
B — Regime-conditional: blend held in Recovery + Consolidation; revert to baseline in Fall. Avoids drawdown amplification. Lag risk: Fall fires after ~10% already absorbed.
C — 200DMA signal: blend held when ticker is above its 200-day MA. Smoother entry/exit than hard regime switch. Whipsaw risk in choppy markets.
